chassis.note: page - 94.49 x 1778.0 x 94.49 mm; the page gives 3.72 in as both the width and the depth, so the section is square (see `gaps`). The length is the 40 rack units of 1.75 in.

color.note: estimated - black powder coat; no photograph is held.

front.note: estimated - the snap cover, fitted, along the whole length; the plate and the walls stand behind it.

guides.note: estimated - the duct is the channel between the two walls, run down the length; no fingers are named.

method.note: FIGURES FROM A PRODUCT PAGE, NO DRAWING. NavePoint publishes no datasheet for this part. The held page (NavePoint product page for 00407296 (40u-vertical-cable-management-black-finish.txt and .html, saved 2026-11-11)) gives the length (70 in) and a 3.72 in width and height in its embedded record, a 3.72 in depth in the description and the table, cold rolled steel with a black powder coat, one channel and a snap cover. The 2D and 3D CAD files the page links are not held. Everything inside the outer size is estimated. No product photograph is held, so the shape was not checked and nothing was copied.

mount.note: estimated - `rack-side`: the page says it is for 19 or 23 in racks and recommends L-brackets (p/n 00407301), two for the 24U and three or four for the 40U and 44U. Which side is a placement's to say; the brackets are not drawn.

rear.note: estimated - the back of the plate, plain.
